title: Korean Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and spicy stir fry dish made with Korean-style chicken, noodles, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Korean chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the gochujang and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the Korean noodles to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly browned.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the green onions and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the Korean chicken noodle stir fry hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
